name: Data Bomb
structure: Lead with a single shocking stat. Show the math. Translate to dollars. Give 3 action steps.
hook_formula: I analyzed [number] [things]. The number that stopped me: [specific stat].
cta_pattern: Comment [KEYWORD] and I'll send you the full breakdown.
example:
I analyzed 500 law firm Google Ads accounts this quarter.

The stat that stopped me: 67% are paying for clicks that never convert.

That's $3,400/month — gone.

Here's why:

1. No call tracking (42% of firms)
2. Broad match keywords eating budget (78%)
3. Landing pages with 6+ form fields (avg 3.2% conversion vs 11.4% for 3 fields)

The fix takes 2 hours.

Comment AUDIT and I'll send you our free Google Ads waste calculator.

name: Failure Story
structure: Open with a specific failure. Show the financial impact. Reveal the root cause. Give the fix. End with action steps.
hook_formula: A [practice area] firm called us last [time period]. Their [problem] was brutal.
cta_pattern: Want to know if this is happening to your firm? Comment CHECK.
example:
A PI firm called us last month.

Their intake numbers were brutal.

90 calls from Google Ads.
34 went to voicemail.
22 rang for 30+ seconds.

That's 47 out of 90 calls — 52% — either unanswered or abandoned.

At $89 per call, they were wasting $4,183 every month.

The fix wasn't more ad budget. It was:

1. Answer in under 10 seconds
2. Add overflow service ($200/mo)
3. Track ring time, not just calls

Speed to lead isn't a buzzword.

Want to know your call answer rate? Comment CHECK.

name: Myth Buster
structure: State the myth. Show why it's wrong with data. Reveal the truth. Give what to do instead.
hook_formula: "[Common advice]" is the worst advice in legal marketing. Here's why:
cta_pattern: What's the biggest marketing myth you've heard? Drop it below.
example:
"Just get more reviews" is the worst advice in legal marketing.

Here's why:

We audited 200 law firm GMB profiles.

Firms with 100+ reviews averaged the SAME conversion rate as firms with 30-50 reviews.

The difference? Response time.

Firms responding to reviews within 24h saw 34% more calls.

Firms with 200+ reviews but no responses? Below average.

Google cares about engagement, not just volume.

What's the biggest marketing myth you've heard? Drop it below.

name: Before/After Framework
structure: Paint the 'before' state with specific numbers. Show the transformation. Reveal the 'after' with exact results. Share 3-5 steps that got there.
hook_formula: [Time period] ago, this [practice area] firm was [specific painful state]. Today: [specific result].

name: Numbered Thread
structure: Tweet 1: Hook with number (X things I learned). Tweet 2-6: One insight per tweet, each standalone. Tweet 7: Summary or call to action. Tweet 8: Repost CTA.
hook_formula: I [did something] for [specific time/number]. Here are [X] things I wish someone told me:
cta_pattern: Reply [KEYWORD] and I'll DM you the full template.
